question: Should delta = 2 (Tuning::max_error, the per-leaf Hamiltonian-error tolerance; default 1) become the sampler default?
task_type: default-flip confirmation: the flip is implemented in this worktree iff the frozen decision rule passes
commit_note: main 33a8e39d (worktree fast-forwarded). Its sampler, kernel and defaults are those of f097391c (the v7 commit): Init::default() = best_of(16) (WP52), Tuning::default() with NonfinitePositionPolicy::RejectLeaf (WP54), DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE = None (WP36). The driver checks src/, integrations/, tests/ and Cargo.toml against 33a8e39d and refuses to run evidence cells if they differ or are dirty.

arms.default: Sampler::new() with only warmup, draws, chains 4, seed, threads 4 and Limits::new().admit_worst_case(); Tuning::default() (delta 1), Metric::default(), Adaptation::default(), Init::default()

A.model_note: the 17 house models of WP34/WP49 (STUDIES/adaptive_delta_v1/protocol.json models)

B.role: decision (gates and |z| only): 4 extra seeds on the two hardest models

C.role: decision: Neal's 10-D funnel tail mass and divergences
C.target: Neal's 10-D funnel, omega ~ N(0, 3^2), x_i | omega ~ N(0, exp(omega)); starts omega in {-3,-1,1,3}, x = 0; four chains, four threads; binary copied from STUDIES/funnel_defaults_30seed_v1 (WP53)
C.seed_note: the same 12 seeds for both arms

seeds_verified_unused: git grep -w over every tracked file of the worktree at 33a8e39d found none of 630601-630604, 630611-630614, 630621-630632 (0 matches each). Smoke seeds 630691-630693 likewise unused and are not evidence.
run_order: Block A: models in listed order; within a model seeds ascending; within a seed default then delta2. Then block B in the same order. Then block C: seeds ascending; within a seed default then delta2. Strictly sequential: one sampling process at a time (the harness does not run two cells concurrently). A failed or errored cell is a result and is never rerun.
models_source: BridgeStan 2.9.0 libraries, data and Stan files copied from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7/models (gitignored)
parameter_set: posteriordb reference-draw columns; ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk and tail (5 %/95 %) ESS; reference z = (mean - ref mean) / sqrt(mcse^2 + mcse_ref^2); max |z| over parameters per cell

statistic.cell: min over reference parameters of bulk ESS / gradients_total (start search, warmup and sampling)
statistic.pair: delta2 / default at the same model and seed; a pair counts if both cells have status ok (gates not required)
statistic.model_ratio: geomean over that model's paired block-A seeds
statistic.primary: paired geomean over A = geomean of the 17 model ratios
statistic.loso: the primary recomputed with each of the 4 block-A seeds left out; minimum of the 4
statistic.gates: count of passing cells per arm over A+B (68 + 8 = 76 cells per arm); an errored cell fails
statistic.z: passing delta2 cells in A+B with max |z| > 4
statistic.funnel_tail: per arm, pooled P(omega < -5) = mean of the 12 per-seed estimates (each pooled over 4 chains x 20,000 draws); between-seed SE = sample sd / sqrt(12). The '1 SE' of the rule and of P4 is the SE of the difference, sqrt(SE_default^2 + SE_delta2^2) (arms independent given the seed; the default's own SE is also reported)
statistic.funnel_divergences: sum over the 12 seeds and 4 chains of retained divergences, per arm

predictions.P3: delta2 gate passes (A+B) within 1 of the default's (|difference| <= 1)
predictions.P4: pooled funnel tail mass of delta2 within 1 SE (of the difference) of the default's
predictions.P5: funnel divergences of delta2 within 1.5x of the default's (ratio in [1/1.5, 1.5]; both zero counts as held)

flip_iff_all: R3: delta2 gate passes (A+B) >= default's minus 1
R4: no passing delta2 cell (A+B) has max |z| > 4
R5: delta2 pooled funnel tail mass is not lower than the default's by more than 1 SE of the difference (and all 12 delta2 funnel cells completed)
R6: delta2 funnel divergences <= 1.5x the default's (if the default has 0, delta2 must have 0; all 12 delta2 funnel cells completed)
decision_rule.also_required: all cells of A, B and C present (an errored cell is present and counts as a failure as above)
decision_rule.if_pass: implement Tuning::default() max_error = 2.0 in src/sampler.rs, update tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs to pin the new default, bump ALGORITHM_REVISION per the walnutpie docs if retained draws under defaults change, add a CHANGELOG entry naming WP63 stating that posteriordb v7 was measured at delta = 1 and a v8 is required, run cargo test (GNU toolchain). Commit on wt/posteriordb-v7; no merge, push or tag.
decision_rule.if_fail: document; change nothing in the library

prior_evidence: WP34 delta2 / default 1.070x; WP49 d2 / da 1.141x over these 17 models on 3 seeds (d2 43 gates); WP53 (30 funnel seeds) delta2 pooled P(<-5) 0.0455 +- 0.0010 vs default 0.0458 +- 0.0014, divergences 37 vs 43.
smoke_tests: Before the freeze commit, the harness and funnel were smoke-tested on eight_schools_noncentered (seeds 630691, 630692) and the funnel (seed 630693) into a scratch directory outside artifacts/; not evidence.
rules: No reruns, no tuning after results; walls contended and not evidence; at most 4 threads per sampling process.
